answer: A single fabricated voice is just an echo off a ledge: loud but empty. Finality here needs K independent non-kin attesters to each verify a distinct piece of genuine work, and that quorum is ferrous, hard and resistant to rust. Sybils can shout in chorus, yet cloned voices share kin edges and get filtered out, so a swarm of copies never crosses the threshold one honest network clears with ease.
